title: The Fifteenth Amendment bars denial of the vote on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude
summary: The Fifteenth Amendment bars denial of the vote on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude.
body: The Fifteenth Amendment says the right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any state on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude. The source says: "tes or by any State on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude." The grounds named are those three. The amendment also gives Congress power to enforce it by appropriate legislation. It does not, in this sentence, mention sex or age.
